title: Kit-first monetization + indexing + YouTube pin cycle

questions_asked.q: Can we automate Request indexing on Google?
questions_asked.decision: No - GSC UI button has no API for normal pages. Automate sitemap PUT + IndexNow + URL Inspection; keep a P0 money URL list for manual Request indexing.

questions_asked.q: I requested indexing for all P0 URLs (or they were already indexed) - verify and give next steps
questions_asked.decision: Verified live: all P0 money URLs indexed (kits/tools crawled today). Switch from indexing work to acquisition (Reddit/Pinterest/YT pin).

questions_asked.q: What's next? How is the YouTube channel for sillgarden doing?
questions_asked.decision: YT is early (38 videos, ~378 views, 1 sub, 0 YT->site). Next = manual distribution; stop shipping volume for its own sake.

questions_asked.q: Let's do #2 - pin kit links on best Shorts
questions_asked.decision: API cannot pin; put kit links first in descriptions + post channel comments; Studio pin pack when quota blocks. Soft-skip YouTube quota so CI does not email false failures.

questions_asked.q: Do YouTube kit refresh once quota resets; ensure GitHub has everything; teach growth agent to learn and do similar
questions_asked.decision: Encode kit-first WORKING/IGNORE rules; make distribution packs kit-first when sessions flat; schedule YT retry after PT midnight.

questions_asked.q: I saw a lot of failed workflow emails
questions_asked.decision: Only 3/200 recent failures - YouTube quota + one push race. Soft-fail quota; OAuth-dead emails only when auth_dead.

questions_asked.q: Automation must learn from this session's questions/decisions/implementations and check impact of its own actions
questions_asked.decision: Store session retros; log every auto action with baseline metrics; re-measure after 3-7 days; promote WORKING / demote FAIL into the playbook.

decision_framework: Diagnose bottleneck with live metrics (sessions, GSC, YT->site, indexing) before shipping more content
When sessions_7d ~ 0: enrichment + acquisition > new thin guides
Monetize with physical kit stacks only - never AI-spittable digital products
Automate what APIs allow; leave human-only steps (GSC Request indexing, Studio pin, Reddit) as paste packs
After shipping money URLs: index/nudge -> distribute -> measure impact -> update playbook

baseline_metrics_at_close.note: Captured at session close for later impact scoring

success_criteria_3_7d: GA4 sessions_7d > 0 from organic or referral
Any affiliate_click events on kit/tool pages
youtube_sessions_7d > 0 after kit links on Shorts
rules_to_keep: Kit-first distribution when traffic is flat
Pause thin new guides while sessions_7d = 0
GSC Request indexing is manual; nudge is automated
YouTube descriptions/comments lead with kits + picker + year-one-cost
Quota soft-skip - never spam failure emails for transient API limits
